units.reason: Seams are settled before anything is written against them.
The transport layer is built last, against a settled contract.

rules.title: The API layer must not import the database session
rules.rationale: An API handler reaching the session directly makes the transport layer un-testable without a database.

rules.title: No module named utils
rules.rationale: A utils module has no owner and no cohesion; it accretes whatever had no home.
